meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 每次回答你之前会先查看过去的对话记录，想起相关的旧信息；每次聊完后会把新谈到的要点存入本地记忆。这些记忆在容器重启后仍然保留。
howto.when: 在与 Claude 的正常对话中，每一次回复前和回复后会自动触发记忆读取与保存；仅当代理运行在 Claude Code 环境下生效。

say.text: 根据我们以前的对话，先总结一下这个项目的现状。
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中提取相关旧信息再回答。

say.text: 你还记得我上次提到的那个命名规则吗？
say.note: 检验它能否回忆出上次的约定。

say.text: 新会话。之前你答应实现的分页功能，现在开始吧。
say.note: 让它从持久记忆里找回未完成的任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks past conversation records before answering, recalls relevant old information, and saves new points after each exchange. Memory is stored locally and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: During normal conversation with Claude, memory read and save are triggered automatically before and after each reply. This only works when the agent runs under Claude Code.

say_en.text: Based on our previous conversations, first summarize the current state of this project.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant old information from memory before answering.

say_en.text: Do you remember the naming convention I mentioned last time?
say_en.note: Tests whether it can recall the earlier agreement.

say_en.text: New session. Start implementing the pagination feature you promised earlier.
say_en.note: It will pick up unfinished tasks from persistent memory.
